question:
Study the given pie chart carefully and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81ad08af71116fb0f52e423849579d7d8a4c71b5a957f6da6e99ca0e0bafc007.png] 

The given pie chart represents the data of Amit's followers on various social networking sites.

If Amit has 40 crore followers on all the networking sites combined, and then the number of 10% of Amit's Twitter followers unfollow him, then what will be the difference between the number of his Twitter followers and the number of his followers on the rest of the networking sites?
solution:
**Given:**

Amit has 40 crore followers in all the networking sites combined.

**Calculation:**

Number of Amit's followers on Twitter if 10% of Twitter followers unfollow him = 90 /100 × 51/100 × 40 crores = 18.36 crores

Difference between the number of his Twitter followers and the number of his followers on the rest of the networking sites = 49/100 × 40 crores - 18.36 crores

= 19.6 crores - 18.36 crores

= 1.24 crores
